title: Characterization of circuit edges
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ input vertices, and let $g$ be a gate such that the gate at index $V-n$ in the circuit's gate list is $g$. If $n\le V$, then $U$ is an argument of $g$ if and only if there is an edge from vertex $U$ to vertex $V$ in the circuit.
hypotheses_covered: The gate-list lookup at index $V-n$ returns $g$
